key_modules_architecture.purpose: Consolidated Executive View for $8M sales, store level breakdown, target food cost % (28-32%), actual food cost %, sales volume, profit margins, and inventory turn rate across Bert's, Rudd's, and Papa Leoni's.
Automated prep list generation from separate prep inventory, prep-to-service container breakdown, and auto-deduction of raw ingredients based on recipe master formulas upon completing batch prep.
Master raw ingredient catalog, par level tracking, unit conversion (oz, lbs, gal, case, portion), cost per unit, stock audit logs, and automatic low-stock notifications.
Detailed recipe builder, sub-recipe nesting, yield percentages, portion cost breakdown, suggested menu pricing, target margin analysis.
AI assistant for inventory cost alerts, recipe optimization, margin troubleshooting, food safety SOPs, and quick query generation for kitchen management.
Shift planner, labor cost percentage tracking against sales, daily opening/closing checklists, kitchen compliance SOPs.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a production-grade React .js application with comprehensive state management supporting 3 distinct restaurant locations plus a consolidated Ownership View.
Implement the Prep Inventory & Daily/Biweekly/Weekly Prep List builder with full auto-deduction logic, sub-container breakdown, and recipe calculation.
Build the Food Costing engine: allow setting target food cost % vs actual food cost %, calculating unit margins, and updating raw ingredient prices dynamically.
Ensure rich visual polish with custom dark slate surfaces, subtle glassmorphism headers, high-contrast visual badges, motion via framer-motion, and interactive data charts with recharts.
Include the AI Chat Assistant panel with pre-configured operational prompts (e.g. 'How to lower pizza dough food cost by 3%?', 'Calculate prep needs for $25k weekend sales').
Include interactive tabs for Future Modules: Scheduling (Shift planner with labor % calculation), Compliance & SOP Checklists, and Staff Training.
Use data-testid on every interactive button, input, select, card, and tab.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use dark colors as heavy flat gradients. Use crisp slate dark surfaces with clean 1px borders (#334155) and inner strokes.
Do NOT center align main layout text. Maintain structured left-aligned grid alignment.
Headers and floating overlays must NOT have transparent backgrounds. Use backdrop-blur with bg-slate-900/90.
All interactive elements MUST include explicit hover/active states with defined text colors.
Use micro-animations with Framer Motion for modal popups, tab switches, list additions, and toast notifications with Sonner.
Ensure every page element uses standard React .js file conventions (JSX syntax in .js files).
